text:
maria: Quick coordination q — planning to push the v2.16 release next week. Need agreement on multi-region cutoff windows. Can APAC go last-night (local) again?
jon: +1 for APAC last. What's the proposed window?
kai: propose: US canary 10:30-11:30 PDT, EU rollout 19:30-20:30 CET, APAC midnight-1am SGT. That gives us 8-9h gap for monitoring.
maria: Sounds reasonable. Note: code freeze cutoff for changelog/branch cut should be 6h before each region's window. So for APAC midnight SGT, cutoff = 18:00 SGT previous day.
ashley: small ask — I have a migration landing in the same release. Can we confirm branch strategy? I plan to target release/v2.16 and feature-flag the migration.
priyam: Feature flags + migration rollout ok. We need a DB migration check during the US canary window. Keep the migration reversible.
kai: good call. Ashley — please add migration rollback instructions in the PR description and a script under infra/migrations/rollback.sh.
ashley: will do.
maria: Reminder: changelog nudges — please add condensed bullet in CHANGELOG.md and ping me 24h before your cutoff for copy review.
priyam: Also callout on observability: add a sampling of requests that exercise the new code path. I can add temporary tracing tags.
jon: Who's on release duty for US canary? I can take it if no conflicts.
maria: jon — assigned. kai will own EU rollout, priyam will eyeball APAC monitoring.
sre-oncall: FYI — we'll schedule increased alerting sensitivity during canaries. I'll post the incident channel link before the window.
priyam: timezone gotchas: DST change next month might shift CET->CEST. Confirmed windows should be in UTC to avoid confusion.
kai: good point. Let's standardize all cutoffs and windows in UTC in the runbook. I'll convert and paste in the release doc.
maria: Cutoff schedule (UTC): code freeze for US canary = 2026-05-15T16:30:00Z, US canary window = 2026-05-15T17:30:00Z-18:30:00Z, EU rollout = 2026-05-15T18:30:00Z-19:30:00Z, APAC window = 2026-05-16T00:00:00Z-01:00:00Z. Confirm?
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.16-canary -> us-west-1 at 2026-05-15T17:30:00Z.
jon: Confirmed. I'll run smoke + end-to-end checks during first 10 minutes.
priyam: I'll validate latency p95 and model QPS during canary. If either degrades >10% we'll abort.
kai: For EU rollout we do 30% traffic shift for first 15m, then 100% if green. For APAC do 10% for 20m then 100%.
maria: Rollback criteria: 1) error rate spike >3x baseline; 2) latency p95 increase >15%; 3) important regression in prompt evals (tagged tests fail). If any trigger, rollback to v2.15 and notify #incidents.
ashley: I've added migration rollback script and PR has changelog entry. Pinged maria for review.
priyam: Can someone add a quick playbook snippet in the release doc with these commands:```bash
# rollback example
kubectl set image deploy/rl-service rl-service=redwood/rl-service:v2.15
./infra/migrations/rollback.sh
```
maria: Added playbook section + monitoring links. Please validate the runbook by EOD tomorrow.
jon: Quick ping for reviewers: I need two approvals on the canary playbook PR. @kai @priyam can you review today?
kai: will review after stand.
priyam: on it — expect comments in 2 hours.
sre-oncall: I'll post the temporary alert thresholds and the link to the pager duty run.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started -> targeting us-west-2. (simulated message)
maria: Thanks team. Last reminder: no last-minute model swaps after code freeze. If you need an emergency change, notify on this thread and call pager. :warning: :thumbsup:
